## Purpose and affected boundary

Describe the exact working-knowledge scope and whether this is a metadata proposal, concept draft, source pointer, review record or rollback.

## Provenance

- [ ] Source object IDs/versions supplied, or `UNKNOWN / NOT YET LINKED` preserved
- [ ] Direct evidence separated from interpretation and synthesis
- [ ] Contradictions, superseded evidence, frozen states and access limits addressed
- [ ] No confidential source files, personal data or keys included

## Admission and authority

- [ ] `HOLD` preserved in absence of genuine human review
- [ ] Any actual reviewer identity/date/decision linked to its original record
- [ ] `ADMIT_TO_WIKI` not conflated with scientific validation or authorized execution
- [ ] No hidden or automatic change to external source evidence

## Verification

- [ ] `python scripts/validate_vault.py .`
- [ ] `python scripts/audit_public.py .`
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`

A green CI check is **not** an admission or research approval.
